purpose: Recall an earlier intention, often one that did not happen.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
express wishes wants obligation permission request advice
Verb dictionary / negative form + つもりだった
I had intended to rest today, but work came up.
I meant to call, but I forgot.
I had intended not to buy anything.
formation: Verb dictionary / negative form + つもりだった
restrictions: A following contrast often explains why the plan changed.
mistake: This describes a past intention, not proof that the action was completed.
